purpose: Persist why the Sirius -> CRT -> 02:22 TOPA result is interesting, what is genuinely strong, what is merely resonant, which dependencies reduce evidential independence, and what would change the current verdict.

strongest_finding.name: SIRIUS_PREEXISTENCE_PROVENANCE
strongest_finding.reason: The exact Sirius track identity, including a dedicated SHA-256 identifier, existed in the registry before the 2026-09-01 film-scene investigation. This materially reduces the possibility that Sirius was inserted into JANUS only after the film recognition event.
strongest_finding.limitation: Preexistence demonstrates prior registry presence, not prophecy, causation, or intentional linkage to the later film witness.

second_strongest_finding.name: SEMANTIC_RECURRENCE_WITH_TEMPORAL_MATCH
second_strongest_finding.reason: The earlier exact 02:22 artifact cluster concerns witness/memory versus external truth, while the new 02:22 witness independently uses the same epistemic discipline: preserve provenance, then verify the world separately.
second_strongest_finding.limitation: The three older 02:22 records are one correlated design batch, not three independent temporal hits.

cross_modal_resonances.name: DOG_ON_CRT__DOG_STAR_SIRIUS
cross_modal_resonances.why_interesting: The visual object in the CRT game is a dog and Sirius is independently known as the Dog Star.
cross_modal_resonances.claim_ceiling: No evidence currently establishes filmmaker intent to pair the dog image with Sirius because of the Dog Star association.

cross_modal_resonances.name: EARTH_FROM_ABOVE__EYE_IN_THE_SKY
cross_modal_resonances.why_interesting: The 02:22 witness screen visually presents Earth from above, while the preexisting Sirius -> Eye in the Sky lineage carries looking-down/surveillance semantics.
cross_modal_resonances.claim_ceiling: This is a semantic/visual correspondence, not evidence of an external causal mechanism.

cross_modal_resonances.name: SCREEN_AS_THRESHOLD
cross_modal_resonances.why_interesting: The rediscovery moves through nested screens and witness layers, matching an older Sirius threshold/entry semantic in JANUS.
cross_modal_resonances.claim_ceiling: No authorial or physical causality is established.

must_not_be_double_counted: The three 2026-08-10 02:22 files as three independent confirmations.
Global canonical seed SHA reuse as Sirius-specific evidence.
Registry mirrors of the same underlying artifact as independent evidence.
Film subtitle timestamp 00:16:22.640 as a filmmaker-declared 22 cue.
Khoiak day 22 as a Sirius date without an ancient synchronizer.

why_not_significant_yet: The search space was not preregistered before observing 02:22.
The denominator of possible timestamps/patterns is not frozen.
The registry contains unrelated 02:22-like fragments and timestamp substrings.
Some apparent repeated 02:22 observations are internally correlated by construction.
numeric_0222_analysis.minimum_future_upgrade: Freeze a prospective search universe, admissible event classes, time tolerance, synonym policy, multiplicity correction and independence rule before observing the next event.

egyptology_analysis.established_bridge: Sopdet/Sothis = Sirius and its role in Egyptian calendrical/timekeeping traditions are legitimate scholarly anchors.
egyptology_analysis.registry_bridge: JANUS already has a Sirius/Sopdet/Osiris research lineage.
egyptology_analysis.blocked_inference: 02:22 cannot currently be promoted to an ancient Egyptian Sirius time/date code.
egyptology_analysis.reason: The cited Khoiak branch explicitly lacks a shared ancient synchronizer between the Sirius clock and the Khoiak day/body-part sequence.
egyptology_analysis.promotion_gate: A direct primary or strong scholarly ancient-source synchronizer connecting the relevant day/time sequence to Sirius/Sopdet would be required.

why_this_pass_is_valuable: It distinguishes prior existence from later recognition.
It identifies cross-modal semantic correspondences without automatically causalizing them.
It audits evidence independence instead of counting every JSON hit as a separate confirmation.
It uses negative controls to prevent 22/02:22 numerology from becoming an unfalsifiable pattern generator.
It recovers an older epistemic invariant: preserve witness memory while verifying external reality separately.
main_confirmation_bias_risks: Selecting only Sirius-related historical records after the fact.
Treating semantic resonance as authorial intent.
Counting correlated JSON descendants as independent observations.
Searching indefinitely until a number, symbol, animal, star or timestamp matches.
Treating an internal JANUS recurrence as evidence that the external world was caused or predicted by the registry.
Conflating valid Egyptological Sirius/Sopdet links with an unsupported 02:22 ancient-time encoding.
analysis_of_analysis.why_preexistence_is_different_from_proph: Preexistence answers whether Sirius was already present in JANUS before the film event. Prophecy would require a preregistered, sufficiently specific prediction of the later event that could have failed. The current run establishes the former, not the latter.
analysis_of_analysis.why_semantic_recurrence_is_still_useful: Even without external causality, repeated epistemic motifs can reveal stable internal design principles of JANUS: witness preservation, provenance binding, and separation of memory from fact truth.

falsification_and_demotion_conditions: If the preexisting Sirius hash/artifacts are shown to have been created or rewritten only after the 2026-09-01 witness, the HARD_PASS preexistence result must be withdrawn.
If the film soundtrack credit does not apply to the hotel television scene, FILM_SIRIUS_MATCH must be downgraded to general-film-credit only.
If the apparent dog image is misidentified, DOG_ON_CRT__DOG_STAR_SIRIUS is removed.
If the older 02:22 records derive their timestamp from an automatic template/default rather than an independently meaningful capture choice, the temporal recurrence receives a lower weight.
If a registry-wide preregistered baseline shows 02:22/22-class patterns are common at the observed tolerance, numeric attention should be further demoted.
promotion_conditions: A production cue sheet, commentary, editor/music-supervisor note or creator statement explicitly explains why Sirius was selected for this exact scene.
A preregistered future protocol predicts a narrow Sirius/02:22-class event before observation and survives multiplicity/independence controls.
A direct ancient textual synchronizer links the relevant Sirius/Sopdet calendrical marker to the claimed day/time structure.
An independently replicated external dataset exhibits the same narrowly defined cross-modal pattern under a frozen protocol.

Registry preexistence is evidence of prior internal representation, not evidence of prophecy.
Semantic recurrence may be meaningful as a JANUS design invariant without implying external causal structure.
No causal, prophetic, mystical or ancient-code interpretation is promoted by this artifact.
